layers.server: server/h2_server.cpp, net_linux.cpp, net_windows.cpp, main.cpp (the transport, one thread per server CPU); arm_p.cpp, requests.cpp (arm P); arm_r.cpp (arm R, reflection)

portable.clang_msan: planned; needs an instrumented libc++, a laptop job

reflection.gcc_asan: planned (pinned GCC 16.2.0, presets linux-gcc1620-asan and linux-gcc1620-e2e, the server layer included, with abseil and protobuf built with the same flags)
reflection.gcc_ubsan: planned without null, nonnull-attribute and returns-nonnull-attribute: with any of them GCC 16 cannot constant-evaluate the layer (design/compiler-findings.md F2)
reflection.gcc_tsan: planned: the server layer has threads (test_server runs two workers and the connection handover); needs a TSan preset and a TSan protobuf build
reflection.msan: gap: GCC has no MSan, and no clang can parse the reflection layer
reflection.clang_tidy: gap: no clang can parse P2996 code
reflection.cppcheck: unknown: not yet tried on P2996 code

portable.msvc_asan: planned (MSVC 19.51, preset msvc-asan); records made on the laptop

server.msvc_asan: blocked, decision open (2026-10-31): preset msvc-e2e-asan builds the transport and arm P on MSVC ASan builds of abseil, protobuf and libnghttp2 (bench/build_deps_msvc.sh), but every program that links protoc's generated code stops before main under MSVC ASan: registering e2e.proto's descriptor parses through protobuf's parse tables while MSVC still initializes them dynamically, and calls a null function (TcParser::TagDispatch; protobuf's port_def.inc says MSVC, unlike clang-cl, cannot guarantee their constant initialization). Debug and RelWithDebInfo alike. The portable layers' msvc-asan record is unaffected

windows.reflection: gap: on Windows only MinGW-w64 GCC 16 builds the reflection layer and arm R, and it has no ASan or UBSan; MSVC and clang-cl have no P2996. The Linux GCC ASan+UBSan and TSan records cover the same first-party inputs (CLAUDE.md D5; p5-typed-endpoints/AGENTS.md line 24)

third_party: protoc, libprotobuf, nghttp2, grpc-go and the load generator are pinned arms or tools, not sanitized first-party code
